page: Microsoft Azure M2ps_v4 is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance running on Microsoft Hyper-V virtualization. Powered by 64-bit ARM processors (arm64), the instance provides 2 dedicated vCPUs paired with 32.0 GB of system memory. This hardware allocation yields a high memory-to-compute ratio of 16.0 GB RAM per vCPU, designed for workloads that require substantial memory capacity relative to compute thread count.

The M2ps_v4 configuration includes no integrated local storage, instead relying on external Azure storage volumes, with support for Premium Storage tiers. The instance does not include graphical processing units (0 GPUs) and does not come with complimentary public IPv4 addresses. Network connectivity and persistent storage throughput must be provisioned via attached Azure network interfaces and remote disk solutions.

Because of its ARM-based architecture and substantial memory density, the instance provides qualitative cost efficiency for memory-bound services that do not require x86 instruction set extensions such as AVX. The high memory ratio makes M2ps_v4 well structured for memory-intensive applications, including in-memory caching layers, Redis instances, small relational databases, and data processing services requiring high RAM footprints without high thread concurrency.
description: Microsoft Azure M2ps_v4 is an ARM-based, memory-optimized virtual machine operating on Microsoft Hyper-V virtualization. It features 2 dedicated 64-bit ARM vCPUs and 32.0 GB of system memory, delivering a high density of 16.0 GB of RAM per vCPU. The instance is provisioned without local storage, requiring attached remote storage such as Premium Storage volumes for operational disk persistence. It does not contain GPU accelerators and includes zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses. Lacking x86-specific vector extensions, the ARM64 architecture provides resource efficiency for workloads that prioritize addressable memory capacity over compute-heavy parallel processing. Given its disproportionate memory capacity relative to core count, the M2ps_v4 instance is technically targeted at memory-constrained operations, including in-memory data structures, Redis key-value caching, lightweight database servers, and small-scale data ingestion pipelines that operate comfortably within a two-thread processing budget.
